Extract language from html lang attribute

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"extract_metadata\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<html lang=\"es\"><head><title>Spanish Page</title></head><body><h1>Hola Mundo</h1><p>Este es un documento en espa\u00F1ol.</p></body></html>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
